env.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
env.description: Secret API key of the stripe() payment adapter (sk_test_... in the sandbox), read on every payment; not needed with stripe({ secretKey }) or another adapter.

env.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
env.description: Signing secret (whsec_...) of the Stripe webhook endpoint that points at stripeWebhookRoute; required when that route is mounted.
